module "@MODULE_BINDINGS@" as bindings
fn check_bindings() -> int {
    let mut seed: int = 17
    let mut iteration: int = 0
    while (< iteration 4) {
        (bindings.mb_reset [1, 8, 16])
        let mut owners: array<int> = []
        let mut names: array<string> = []
        let mut targets: array<string> = []
        let mut definitions: array<int> = []
        let mut n: int = 0
        while (< n 512) {
            set seed (% (+ (* seed 251) 11) 32749)
            let owner: int = (- (% seed 7) 2)
            let name: string = (+ "key:" (int_to_string (% seed 47)))
            let target: string = (+ "target:" (int_to_string n))
            let definition: int = (% seed 3)
            let mut found: int = -1
            let mut i: int = 0
            while (< i (array_length names)) {
                if (and (== (at owners i) owner) (== (at names i) name)) { set found i }
                set i (+ i 1)
            }
            if (< found 0) {
                set found (array_length names)
                set owners (array_push owners owner)
                set names (array_push names name)
                set targets (array_push targets target)
                set definitions (array_push definitions definition)
            }
            (bindings.mb_add_target owner name target definition)
            assert (== (bindings.mb_lookup owner name) (at targets found))
            assert (== (bindings.mb_target_owner owner name) (at definitions found))
            assert (== (bindings.mb_lookup owner "missing") "missing")
            assert (== (bindings.mb_target_owner owner "missing") owner)
            set n (+ n 1)
        }
        let mut j: int = 0
        while (< j (array_length names)) {
            assert (== (bindings.mb_lookup (at owners j) (at names j)) (at targets j))
            assert (== (bindings.mb_target_owner (at owners j) (at names j)) (at definitions j))
            set j (+ j 1)
        }
        set iteration (+ iteration 1)
    }
    (bindings.mb_reset [1, 8])
    (bindings.mb_add_target 1 "2:x" "first" 0)
    (bindings.mb_add_target 12 "x" "second" 1)
    assert (== (bindings.mb_lookup 1 "2:x") "first")
    assert (== (bindings.mb_lookup 12 "x") "second")
    (bindings.mb_add_target 0 "value" "local" 0)
    assert (bindings.mb_import_global 0 "value" "imported" 1)
    assert (bindings.mb_import_global 0 "value" "imported" 1)
    assert (not (bindings.mb_import_global 0 "value" "other" 1))
    assert (not (bindings.mb_import_global 0 "value" "imported" 0))
    assert (== (bindings.mb_lookup 0 "value") "local")
    assert (== (bindings.mb_target_owner 0 "value") 0)
    (bindings.mb_reset [])
    (bindings.mb_add_target 0 "value" "ignored" 0)
    assert (== (bindings.mb_lookup 0 "value") "value")
    assert (== (bindings.mb_target_owner 0 "value") -1)
    return 0
}
shadow check_bindings { assert (== (check_bindings) 0) }
fn main() -> int { return (check_bindings) }
shadow main { assert (== (main) 0) }
